title: Proposition 5.3: pushout of a closed subtopos along a geometric morphism
statement_scope: Let X be an ∞-topos, U a subobject of the final object of X (a (−1)-truncated object), and X/U the corresponding closed subtopos. Suppose given a geometric morphism f*:X/U→Y and form the pushout of X/U→X and X/U→Y in Top, with resulting maps f'*:X→Z and g'*:Y→Z. Let V=f'*(U)∈Z. Then: (1) f'* induces an equivalence X/U≃Z/V; (2) g'* is fully faithful with essential image Z/V, and in particular g'* is a closed immersion. Whole proposition and both assertions are retained.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: the unit is a substantial research-bearing topological construction, identifying a pushout of ∞-topoi as a homotopy fiber product, constructing V from the closed subtopos and proving both the equivalence X/U≃Z/V and the closed-immersion/essential-image description of g'* (statement page 26; proof pages 26-27). This is beyond routine qualifying-exam work and is a core input to Theorem 5.1.
